text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It seems all our summer training has finally blossomed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Tighten the chin strap of your helmet after a victory," as the saying goes. I cannot afford to be complacent here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Next time, please...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Take me to the stage of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please let Nakayama at the year's end
be the battleground for my showdown with her.
choice_data_list: So you're going to challenge Maruzensky...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, that was the goal
I have strived toward all along.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“No Retreat”—
I will not go back on my vow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Her status as ‘Monster II’ is already rock-solid.
All that's left is to become the true ‘Monster’...!”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And... oh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, did someone just...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, El...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...?
I wonder what's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Normally, El would be venting her frustration much more... forcefully than this.
Just then... El Condor Pasa's sheer tenacity from summer camp flashed through my mind.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —That's why it has to be me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In the boiling blue upon the turf...
What will be reflected in those eyes is, without a doubt...!

"...Right now, Grass Wonder is solely focused
on her showdown with Maruzensky."
"Could it be that for El Condor Pasa, it—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer...?
Whatever is the matter?
"Still, this is a crucial turning point for Grass Wonder."

"Telling her now, when she is so finely honed and focused,
would not be a wise move."
Thinking that, I held my tongue.
